_comment: Threshold requirements, Nevada 2026. Section 6 Pre-Scoring Threshold Requirements, PDF pp.16-24, plus the two minimum scores (p.6 for 9%, p.37 for bond), the energy requirements of Section 5 (p.16), the threshold amenity table in 7.3.3 (p.29) and the additional bond criteria of 8.1 (pp.36-37). Section 6.20 Post-Award Changes is a post-award obligation rather than an application threshold and is not extracted. Appendix C (pp.51-52) scores Nevada transferable state tax credits with its own 'threshold point criteria' (1 point per unit at 30-50% AMI, 2 per unit at or below 30%, minimum 8 or 12 points by project size); that is a separate state credit program, not LIHTC scoring, and is not extracted.

criteria.heading: Minimum score, 60% of available points
criteria.quote: Applications must earn at least 60% of the available points to be eligible for
criteria.note: Stated as a share rather than a number, so its value depends on the unresolved total: 60% of the stated 97 is 58.2, while the itemised maxima put a non-Tribal project's ceiling at 110 (66 points). See NV_2026.json track_totals.

criteria.heading: Minimum bond score for Division funding resources
criteria.native_category: Scoring for Tax Exempt Bond Project Applications
criteria.quote: The minimum threshold to be considered for Division funding resources is
criteria.note: 70 out of 100, where every eligible project starts at 60, so a bond project needs 10 of the 40 additional points. The 70 governs access to GAHP funds and state tax credits, not the 4% credits themselves.

criteria.heading: Energy requirements
criteria.quote: Projects must show a minimum improvement of 20% upon the final
criteria.note: New construction must meet IECC standards adopted after 2021, validated by an unaffiliated third party; rehabilitation must improve its HERS rating by at least 20%. The 7.3.8 Energy Star points are for exceeding this.

criteria.heading: Market study
criteria.quote: All Market Studies must comply with Appendix A, Market Study Guide.
criteria.note: Applications may be ineligible where comparable affordable projects are under 90% occupied, where the project would significantly harm other publicly funded projects, or where proposed rents equal or exceed market.

criteria.heading: Compliance and affordability period; Qualified Contract waiver
criteria.quote: foregoing the Qualified Contract process.
criteria.note: All 4% and 9% applicants waive the Qualified Contract process. The extended use period may be extended in 5-year increments to 50 years, which is what 7.3.5 scores.

criteria.heading: Fair housing accessibility
criteria.quote: The project architect must certify the improvements will comply with Fair Housing Act accessibility

criteria.heading: Income and rent restriction election
criteria.quote: Applicant must select one of the following elections:
criteria.note: 40/60, 20/50, or average income.

criteria.heading: Maximum costs for 9% projects
criteria.quote: All projects are subject to the maximum cost per unit, excluding land costs.
criteria.note: Clark County $530,000 per unit for rent to own and Tribal, $350,000 for all other new construction; other counties $540,000 and $370,000. Acquisition/rehab: a maximum rehab line item of $120,000 in Clark and $130,000 elsewhere, within $350,000 and $370,000 total per unit. The 7.3.9.B scoring ladder pays a point at rehab costs above the Clark $120,000 cap; see NV_2026.json. Waivers are available but cost 3 points under Section 16.

criteria.heading: Replacement reserves
criteria.quote: Project Reserves for Replacement Requirements
criteria.note: $250 per unit a year for senior projects, $300 for other new construction, $325 for other acquisition/rehab.

criteria.heading: Financial feasibility
criteria.quote: Minimum debt service coverage ratio of 1.15x on primary debt service
criteria.note: Also caps developer fee at 15% and contractor fee at 14%, the ceilings that 7.4.4 and 7.4.5 score against, and bars uncommitted gap financing from outside the Division.

criteria.heading: Authorization and due formation
criteria.quote: Authorization and Due Formation

criteria.heading: Site control
criteria.quote: Site Control for all the land needed for the proposed project must be evidenced by one of the following:
criteria.note: A purchase contract, option, government commitment or recorded deed, running at least to December 31 of the reservation year. The 7.3.2 points require more: fee simple title, or a long lease for tribes and PHAs.

criteria.heading: Project readiness
criteria.quote: all funding sources must be secured prior to the award of LIHTCs.
criteria.note: Financial close within 270 days of the reservation under NAC 319.981.

criteria.heading: Zoning and Phase I environmental study
criteria.quote: appropriately zoned land and that no discretionary permits are necessary
criteria.note: The Phase I must be no more than two years old at the application deadline.

criteria.heading: Low-income housing experience
criteria.quote: Applicants/Co-Applicants with no prior LIHTC experience must either enter into joint ventures or hire
criteria.note: Special Needs and Supportive Housing sponsors need three years of relevant experience.

criteria.heading: Compliance history
criteria.quote: A project in material non-compliance resulting in a Form 8823 or other similar notification may result in
criteria.note: 7.6 offers a 5-point deduction in place of ineligibility for unresolved non-compliance.

criteria.heading: Current on Division fees
criteria.quote: Applicants/Co-Applicants must be current on any debt or fees owed to the Division.

criteria.heading: Background disclosures
criteria.quote: The Division may reject an application based on the information in the Background Disclosure.
criteria.note: Notarized, covering bankruptcies and regulatory actions over seven years, defaults, foreclosures, fraud and debarment.

criteria.heading: Nevada-based companies and products
criteria.quote: Applicant/Co-Applicants will employ at least two third-party Nevada based
criteria.note: Distinct from the 2 points in 7.3.4 for the applicant itself being Nevada-based.

criteria.heading: Project security and management
criteria.quote: All projects (excluding eventual tenant ownership) must provide three of the following:
criteria.note: Three of eight listed security measures; closed-circuit monitoring and sprinklers in multi-story new construction of 40 or more units; management staff attend Division compliance training.

criteria.heading: Division surveys and small business outreach reports
criteria.quote: Project Sponsors must participate in all NHD surveys and submit a quarterly report detailing efforts made to

criteria.heading: Landscaping and project plans
criteria.quote: Plant material must be appropriate to the local climate and should reflect a high sensitivity towards water
criteria.note: The 5 points in 7.3.6 are for going further, to 75% desert or xeriscape landscaping.

criteria.heading: Local jurisdiction notification
criteria.quote: evidence of delivery of and a copy of the letter notifying
criteria.note: Evidence of a letter to the local chief executive officer inviting comment.

criteria.heading: Internet access infrastructure
criteria.quote: All projects will include infrastructure for broad-band internet connection in all units.
criteria.note: Infrastructure only; free in-unit internet earns 2 amenity points in 7.3.3.

criteria.heading: Promoting the Division
criteria.quote: All Applicants/Co-Applicants must promote the Division’s participation in the project during construction

criteria.heading: Promoting the property on NVHousingSearch.org
criteria.quote: beginning with lease-up and through the extended use period
criteria.note: Listings updated at least quarterly from lease-up through the extended use period.

criteria.heading: Threshold project amenity requirements
criteria.quote: Threshold Project Amenity Requirements
criteria.note: A matrix by project type and size requiring community rooms, washer/dryer provision, playgrounds, handrails, elevators and, for rent to own, minimum unit and lot sizes and a one-car garage. Required amenities earn no points under 7.3.3. The matrix's column-to-row mapping does not survive the text layer and was not coded cell by cell. The Division may waive required amenities for acquisition/rehab and scattered-site projects.

criteria.heading: Additional criteria for tax exempt bond projects
criteria.native_category: Tax Exempt Bond Project Scoring and Additional Criteria
criteria.quote: Tax Exempt Bond applications must include evidence of a transfer of 50% of the necessary Private
criteria.note: Eight conditions including a 50% volume cap transfer or local endorsement, Board of Finance approval, financial close within 180 days, and the Section 42 50% test.
